description:
## Duration, Distance, Terrain
1.5 hours
1 mile at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
Mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines
## About
There are clues all around Copley Square that are connected to Aesop's Fables. Do we know why these clues are here? What do they refer to? Join us on this family-friendly tour around Copley Square to find these clues and learn the fables and stories they represent.
## Meeting location:
Meet your guide in front of the Dartmouth Street entrance to the Boston Public Library

Finding Your Guide: All guides carry an 8×11 sign that says “Boston By Foot Walking Tours.”

Nearest Accessible MBTA Station: Copley (Green Line)
## What to bring
Comfortable shoes, dress for the weather, water bottle
